INEI administrative boundaries

Source: R/inei.R
inei.Rd

Download the official political-division geometries published by the National Institute of Statistics and Informatics (INEI): https://ide.inei.gob.pe/. All three helpers share the same download / extract / read pipeline with a cli progress bar.

Details

  • get_departaments() — level-1 (departamento).

  • get_provinces() — level-2 (provincia).

  • get_districts() — level-3 (distrito).

Column names are normalised to lowercase (except the geometry column).

Developed by antony barja.
